c74object.name: bbb.dmx.matrixmap
c74object.digest: Sample jit.matrix colors into fixture parameters across multiple DMX universes.
c74object.description: Loads a bbb.dmx fixture patch and a matrix map JSON file, samples color data from a Jitter matrix, writes mapped fixture parameters, and outputs 512-channel DMX universe lists. It can target fixture ids directly or resolve fixture groups from an optional groups JSON file.

inlets.inlet: jit_matrix, file loading, bang, reload, and dump input.

outlets.outlet: DMX data. In selected-universe mode this is a 512-value list. In all or changed mode this is universe id followed by 512 values.

method.name: readsetup
method.description: Read a shared bbb.dmx.setup.v1 JSON file immediately. Paths inside setup are resolved relative to the setup file, and explicit object attributes override setup values.

method.name: readpatch
method.description: Read a fixture patch JSON file immediately. Relative paths are resolved by Max against the patch/search path.

method.name: readmap
method.description: Read a matrix map JSON file immediately. The map describes fixture ids or groups, sample points or regions, and parameter bindings.

method.name: readgroups
method.description: Read an optional bbb.dmx groups JSON file. Matrix map entries may target group names when groups are loaded.

method.name: readoverrides
method.description: Read an optional semantic overrides JSON file. Overrides add parameter aliases and profile/mode-specific semantic color behavior.

method.name: jit_matrix
method.description: Process a registered Jitter matrix by name. char and float32 matrices are supported.

method.name: bang
method.description: Output the current mapped universe buffers.

method.name: reload
method.description: Reload the current patch, matrix map, groups, and semantic overrides files when their paths are set.

method.name: dump
method.description: Output load and validation state, resolved paths, effective settings, pending loads, and explicit attribute-override flags from the status outlet.

attribute.name: setup
attribute.description: Optional shared bbb.dmx.setup.v1 JSON path. Loaded after object initialization and whenever the attribute changes.

attribute.name: patch
attribute.description: Fixture patch JSON path to read after object initialization and whenever the attribute changes. Attribute loading is deferred; use readpatch for immediate explicit loading.

attribute.name: map
attribute.description: Matrix map JSON path to read after object initialization and whenever the attribute changes. Attribute loading is deferred; use readmap for immediate explicit loading.

attribute.name: groups
attribute.description: Optional groups JSON path to read after object initialization and whenever the attribute changes.

attribute.name: group
attribute.description: Alias for groups. Useful for patchers that read better as @group path.json.

attribute.name: semantic_overrides
attribute.description: Optional semantic overrides JSON path to read after object initialization and whenever the attribute changes.

attribute.name: universe
attribute.description: Selected output universe for selected universe output mode.

attribute.name: universe_mode
attribute.description: Output mode: all, selected, or changed.

attribute.name: plane_order
attribute.description: Matrix plane order: rgba, argb, bgra, or gray.

attribute.name: gamma
attribute.description: Gamma applied to sampled values. 1.0 leaves values unchanged.

attribute.name: autobang
attribute.description: When non-zero, output automatically after a jit_matrix is processed. When zero, matrix input only updates the internal frame and bang is required to emit DMX; the first matrix received while disabled reports a warning.

attribute.name: invert_x
attribute.description: When non-zero, mirror normalized sample coordinates horizontally.

attribute.name: invert_y
attribute.description: When non-zero, mirror normalized sample coordinates vertically.

attribute.name: color_use_white
attribute.description: RGBW semantic matrix color behavior. When zero, RGBW white parameters are left untouched.

attribute.name: color_wheel_fallback
attribute.description: When non-zero, semantic RGB mappings may drive nearest color-wheel slots when no RGB, RGBW, or CMY model exists.
